definitions.gloss: mixed tenancy; mixed-use occupancy; cohabitation of diverse tenants
definitions.explanation: A situation where different types of businesses, shops, or residents share the same building or area. Most commonly seen in the term {雑居|ざっきょ}ビル (mixed-use building).

examples.japanese: {雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三階|さんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The office is on the third floor of a mixed-use building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Mixed-use buildings line the area in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Old mixed-use buildings sometimes have inadequate fire prevention measures.

notes:
USAGE:
{雑居|ざっきょ} most commonly appears in the compound {雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧, referring to a building housing a miscellaneous mix of small businesses — bars, restaurants, clinics, offices, and other establishments all in one building. These are very common in Japanese cities, especially near train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧ (mixed-use building — the most common usage)
- {雑居|ざっきょ}⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧ (mixed-use district)
- {雑居|ざっきょ}{房|ぼう} (shared prison cell)

CHARACTERISTICS:
{雑居|ざっきょ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧ typically have narrow stairways, many small tenants on each floor, and often host nightlife establishments. They are a distinctive feature of Japanese urban landscapes.
